description: This file contains the 'Log' class, which serves as a helper utility for logging within the Android application. It provides static methods for different log levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), manages a chain of LogNode objects for handling log output, and includes constants for log levels. The class acts as a wrapper around Android's native android.util.Log, adding custom chaining functionality.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging with chaining support and log level constants.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode for log message handling.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception to the current LogNode.
